Resolves relative Open Graph and Twitter card addresses and drops those the crawler cannot fetch

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using Crawlberg;

var engine = CrawlbergConverter.CreateEngine(null);
var url = "https://example.com";
var result = await CrawlbergConverter.ScrapeAsync(engine, url);
Console.WriteLine(result.StatusCode);
Console.WriteLine(result.Metadata.OgImage);
Console.WriteLine(result.Metadata.TwitterImage);
Console.WriteLine(result.Metadata.OgUrl);
Console.WriteLine(result.Metadata.OgVideo);
Console.WriteLine(result.Metadata.OgAudio);
```
